title: Death Stranding Costs You 25¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Death Stranding Director's Cut is $9.99 on Steam this week (75% off $39.99) and the main story takes about 40 hours (HowLongToBeat): 25¢ an hour. Full price is $1 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 27 Nov), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with 300 hours in Death Stranding: it's $9.99 this week, 25¢ an hour.
